profile.name: Prateek Gupta
profile.title: Java Full Stack Developer · AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.bio: I build and optimize enterprise web applications for banking and government clients with Java, Spring, React and Python/Django, and I ship faster with a Claude-driven, spec-first development workflow.
about: I'm a Java Full Stack Developer with 3 years of software experience: 2.5+ years at Virtual Galaxy Infotech plus a 6-month full-stack Java internship. I build, optimize and deploy enterprise web applications for banking and government clients using Java, Spring MVC/Spring Boot, JSP, React, Python/Django, Oracle and PostgreSQL.

My edge is AI-native engineering. I architected a Claude-driven development workflow with spec- and plan-driven builds, reviewed AI proposals and staged releases, and I use AI-assisted profiling to re-engineer slow SQL and stored procedures without changing business logic.
I care about speed, security and maintainability. I own live production deployments for multiple HelpDesk CRM client instances and turn performance bottlenecks into measurable wins.
profile.collaboration: Open to remote full-stack, Java/Spring, Python/Django and AI-first engineering roles, as well as freelance and project-based work.

experience.description: Enterprise web applications for banking and government clients, from AI-assisted platform builds to performance engineering and production releases.

groups.title: AI-Assisted Engineering | APMC Platform
points: Architected a Claude-driven development workflow integrated with the project repository and GitHub branch-based version control, enforcing a single approved architecture across all AI-generated modules and preventing scope drift.

Directed delivery through requirement and design specifications maintained in Markdown, reviewing and approving or rejecting AI proposals at each stage; completed security, traffic-handling and performance reviews before release.

Established a staged release process: module-level testing after every development cycle, Docker-based validation, merge to main and UAT deployment; ran scoped automated build sessions against finalized plans to shorten delivery timelines.
Built a high-performance, animated UI with GSAP motion transitions, balancing visual polish against load performance.

groups.title: HelpDesk CRM | Multi-Client Ticketing Platform
points: Led platform-wide performance optimization through code review and refactoring: cut page load times by up to 75% (20s to 5s; 10s to 1-4s), improved maintainability by 75% and added server-side caching for static responses.
Eliminated repeated database round trips by moving bulk submissions to array-based stored-procedure inputs, reducing submission time from 2-3s to 50-200ms.

Drove AI-assisted SQL optimization: profiled the slowest stored procedures and dependent queries with Claude, re-engineered them while preserving business logic, and validated on live and local databases, making chart and dashboard workloads 5-6x faster.

Engineered an internal Procedure Performance Monitoring portal that records execution time, errors, input parameters and affected users per stored procedure, enabling root-cause analysis and proactive bottleneck detection.
Enabled GZIP compression at the WildFly (Undertow) server level and redesigned the UI as mobile-responsive with user-selectable color themes and motion transitions.
Delivered HighCharts analytics dashboards (status-wise, weekly, monthly, yearly), Tour & Travel and UAT modules, and an AI-powered circular summarization feature.
Adapted one product into multiple client-specific configurations, including a public-facing complaint registration portal, delivering on schedule for banking and government clients.

groups.title: Production Deployment & Release Management
points: Own end-to-end production deployment across all HelpDesk CRM environments on WildFly: server and datasource configuration, client mail-server integration and environment troubleshooting with the server and support teams.
Manage Linux server deployments from Windows using WinSCP (SFTP/SCP), resolving cross-platform compatibility issues during live rollouts.

groups.title: Earlier Projects
points: Contributed to ESS, HRMS, Animal Husbandry (React, Django) and HelpDesk CRM v1; owned React UI and client-side logic on the Django-based projects.
Developed HRMS modules including payroll, employee management, leave management, training and examination systems.
Designed flow-based modules such as Tour Plan, Tour Advance, Tour Extension Requests and Tour Bill approvals with multi-level (manager and accounts) authorization.
Contributed to the Employee Productivity System (EPS) for an international client with a modular architecture.

responsibilities: Managed logistics operations, trained new hires and resolved customer escalations with a 95% satisfaction rate.
